items.title: A maker swapped a bowling alley's $120k scoring rig for $1,600 of ESP32s
items.why: An ESP-NOW mesh of cheap microcontrollers replaces proprietary 2008-era hardware - steal the pattern for any arcade or shop build.

items.title: An AI edited another model's weights directly - critics say it just fixed a loop
items.why: The 6x math-score jump mostly came from stopping Qwen's infinite-loop failure in two layers, not new reasoning ability, replication shows.

items.title: A world-model game AI small enough to run entirely on a $6 microcontroller
items.why: A 26-131k-parameter looped transformer 'dreams' Breakout and Pac-Man frames on a Pi Pico 2W - a clean intro to on-device RL.

items.title: One log line can write 49KB to disk because of how systemd-journald stores it
items.why: A two-line-per-second service can cost ~50 IOPS; forward to syslog or cap journald if your disk writes look mysteriously high.

items.title: A precisely timed sound burst during sleep boosted the brain's waste-clearing waves
items.why: Small n=14 pilot in Science Translational Medicine; no sleep-quality or memory outcome tested yet, so don't expect a gadget soon.

items.title: Ice baths didn't beat heat or just resting for recovering muscle strength
items.why: 40-person RCT found cold, heat and passive recovery all restored strength equally after hard exercise - skip the cold-plunge hype.

items.title: A safer way to let coding agents run code: keep the agent out of the sandbox
items.why: Agent stays outside; only its code runs inside a disposable VM behind an allow-list proxy - worth copying before trying local models.

items.title: A monotonic-stack trick turns many O(N^2) DP transitions near-linear
items.why: Keep a Pareto-frontier stack of range-stat/best-dp pairs when cost depends on a range min, GCD or OR - handy for large-N DP problems.

items.title: Five git-log commands worth running before you read any unfamiliar codebase
items.why: Churn, bus-factor, bug-cluster and hotfix-frequency one-liners flag which files are risky before you open a single file.

items.title: OpenAI's new agent model stalls itself asking questions it could just answer
items.why: Two hours into a solo task, Astra 'blocked' itself over a filename choice it had full context to make - a real limit on long agent runs.
